title: Buga Sphere symbols recognised by Mario Woods and Randy Anderson
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Buga Sphere symbols recognised by Mario Woods and Randy Anderson, about 2025 (Mario Woods' experience 1977) at Buga, Colombia; Ellsworth Air Force Base, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Buga, Colombia; Ellsworth Air Force Base

tellings.quote: is I showed photos of the symbols to Mario Woods and to Randy Anderson. Mario Woods, 1977 Ellsworth Air Force Base experiencer.

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, says he showed photos of the symbols on the Buga Sphere, a metal ball found in Buga, Colombia, to two men, Mario Woods and Randy Anderson. Woods says he had a strange encounter in 1977 at Ellsworth Air Force Base, a US military base, and Michels says both men recognised the symbols. If true, that would tie the sphere to their own earlier experiences.
